description: The ENTER half of the ENTER-versus-REENTER pair, and the only case in this folder that reaches app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:83-87 carrying a COMMAREA. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives as 0, so NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :83 is true: the program flips the context to re-enter at :84, moves LOW-VALUES over the whole output map at :85, places the cursor on FNAMEL at :86 and paints at :87, then falls to the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('CU01') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :107-110. Nothing is validated, nothing is read from the five data fields and USRSEC is never opened - which is why no AID is declared here, since EIBAID is not evaluated on this path and declaring a key would imply that it mattered. Two consequences of :85 are pinned. The MOVE blanks the header too, but SEND-USRADD-SCREEN at :184-196 immediately repopulates the six header fields through POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :214-233 and only then moves WS-MESSAGE into ERRMSGO, so just the five DATA fields are still LOW-VALUES when the map goes out - x'00' at each declared width, which is a different observable from the SPACES that INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS writes at :287-295 on the PF4 path. case15 is that PF4 half, and the pair exists so that a translation which used one figurative constant for both cannot pass both. ERRMSGC is x'00' for the same reason, which is DFHBMSCA's DFHDFCOL: DFHGREEN is written only on the success arm at :254, and nothing here writes DFHRED or a '*' marker, because COUSR01C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY and its COPY DFHATTR at :57 is commented out. And the returned CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1, so the next call takes the other branch: the context flip travels in the payload, not in a session. Two widths are derived rather than asserted. The seed is 57 characters because app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 carries SEC-USR-ID 8 + SEC-USR-FNAME 20 + SEC-USR-LNAME 20 + SEC-USR-PWD 8 + SEC-USR-TYPE 1 and stops there, while app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 adds SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) to reach 80, so the one declared normalisation pads 57 to 80 at seed time and the ten expectedFinalState rows are stated at the copybook's full 80 with that FILLER present. The message narrows 80 to 78 because WS-MESSAGE is PIC X(80) while ERRMSGO of COUSR1AO is PIC X(78) in app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY; on this path both are blank, since :75-76 moved SPACES into WS-MESSAGE and ERRMSGO before the branch was taken, so the two channels are 80 spaces and 78 spaces rather than a truncated literal. The duplicate-key arm this folder also needs is deliberately not here: app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:260-261 is a single shared arm written as two consecutive WHEN clauses with no statements between them, and case08 forces DUPKEY while case09 collides with the ADMIN001 that app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35 seeds to obtain DUPREC, so both halves of that arm are owned and neither is duplicated here. Provenance (practice B12, risk R-A): every expected value above is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:83-87, :107-110, :184-196, :214-233 and :287-295, cross-checked against app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23, app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY, app/bms/COUSR01.bms, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD, app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 and :64-73 - KEYS(8,0) RECORDSIZE(80,80) INDEXED, which is what makes a key collision detectable at all - and app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy's two forty-character titles, whose CCDA alternative is commented out. The clock is pinned to the source's own version footer at app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:298, 2022-07-19 23:12:34, so no wall clock is consulted and the code page is named US-ASCII rather than defaulted. None of it was captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL, which AAP 0.7.6 proves impossible in this environment across eight independently verified blockers and 0.9.11 escalates for explicit confirmation.
